name: smoke-e2-noslh
description: Pipeline test of E2 without SLH-DSA, never used for results: the 18 algorithms outside SLH-DSA and every operation through the probe pass, the E2 probe pass, E2 and E2c, with tiny budgets (fast: 10 warm-up + 200 samples; slow: 1 s and at least 3 samples) and 1 repetition.
